narrative: The three sentences already on the leaf, the ink dry, the pounce dull. The right margin beside them is empty. No strike through any word. The new pen is wet. One line under the fair lines, the ink still wet. It is not struck. The margin is still empty. No glass in the room. Empty margin. The pen is set in the fold. The wet line can still be smudged. He does not smudge it. Ink on the finger.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the order under the three sentences and left the margin empty.
